checksReviewed.result: False-positive/confirmed classification and FULL/PARTIAL/REJECTED appeal are explicit codes. Only RESOLVED accepts one record per independent dimension per cycle. REOPEN clears current outcome projection without deleting history; later classification requires a new resolution.

No historical classification is fabricated/backfilled. A currently resolved valid bounded case may receive a manual HR finding through the existing ledger. Workbench retains correction-state checks and malformed/contradictory contexts fail closed. Terminal resolution/reopen rollout is not activated.

Outcome recording filters validated effective persisted grants to HR_ADMIN and uses existing scoped TEAM_EXCEPTION_DECIDE. TEAM_MANAGER and TENANT_ADMIN permissions remain unchanged. Token is actor/tenant/action/revision bound; capability, historical team/site resource and effective HR grant are read again after case fence before a new append.

Existing case and organization-operation locks, contiguous revision bound, exact replay comparison and atomic decision/audit transaction remain. Generic inactive foundation writer rejects reserved outcomes. Conflicting payloads and stale non-replay revisions cannot append.

Authoritative decision contains actor, protected reason, operation, revision and server timestamp under existing append-only production trigger and composite tenant FKs. Queue/report/API success and aggregate audit omit protected reasons/raw proof. UI/route require reason; uncertain retries retain original reason and operation.

CASE_RECORDED_AT cohort and RepeatableRead snapshot remain. Full bounded revision/date/lifecycle validation precedes metrics. False-positive and appeal denominators are independent; PARTIAL is separate. Zero samples yield null percentages; unfinished/reopened/unclassified/corrupt cases are excluded from final denominators. Correction links never classify outcomes.

Known bounded server action codes control rendered buttons. Explicit labels and four percentages are separate. Reason field is labeled, required and 3-1000 characters. Initial render offers no action until scoped server data. Pending submit plus tenant/token refs prevent stale completions from applying to another tenant. No automated payroll/discipline/personnel action introduced.

Opt-in dispatch jobs require full expected_head equality to checkout/GITHUB_SHA, accepted-parent ancestry and unchanged actual test/typecheck baselines. Separate read-only report and narrow classification fixtures use isolated hosted PostgreSQL/Redis and masked ephemeral auth. ubuntu-24.04 jobs have timeout bounds. Focused source/harness trigger paths included. No production environment/secrets or deploy action.
